title.value: Findings of the 2nd Shared Task on Multi-lingual Multi-task Information Retrieval at MRL 2024
title.justification: The title is directly mentioned at the beginning of the paper's text.
title.quote: Findings of the 2nd Shared Task on Multi-lingual Multi-task Information Retrieval at MRL 2024

analysis.description: This paper presents the findings of the second shared task on multilingual multitask information retrieval, focusing on the evaluation of large language models (LLMs) in under-resourced languages. It includes tasks such as named entity recognition (NER) and reading comprehension (RC) in languages like Azerbaijani, Swiss German, Turkish, and Yorùbá. The paper details the data preparation, evaluation methodology, results, and winning systems for these tasks.

type.justification: The paper provides empirical results from system evaluations in multilingual multitask settings.
type.quote: We evaluate the overall system performance on the generative task using automatic metrics...
